WITH state_sums AS (
  SELECT c.state_county_province AS state,
         SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS amount
  FROM Financial_Transactions AS ft
  JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.invoice_number = ft.invoice_number
  JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
  JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.state_county_province
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount
  FROM state_sums
),
state_shares AS (
  SELECT s.state, s.amount,
         1.0 * s.amount / NULLIF(g.total_amount, 0) AS share
  FROM state_sums AS s
  CROSS JOIN grand_total AS g
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
  FROM state_shares
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT ss.amount, ss.share, ss.share - a.avg_share AS excess
  FROM state_shares AS ss
  CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
  WHERE ss.share > a.avg_share
)
SELECT SUM(amount), AVG(share), AVG(excess)
FROM above_average
